component.name: Railbench
component.summary: Model railway track planning and simulation tool

description.p: Railbench is an intuitive, accurate track planning and layout simulation application supporting major scale models (H0, TT, N, etc.) with exact geometries, snapping, and electrical voltage drop analysis.

Release 0.4.0: Märklin C-Track Turntable 74862 (23m DB standard type) & Trix 66862 with 30 exits, 3D Engine Shed environment & scenery model, 3D wood plate sub-structures, H0/N street systems, and point-to-point distance measurement tool.
Release 0.3.0: Continuous ramp generation (Dreisatz & S-curve easement), 2D/3D slope visualizer, left-click marquee box selection, right-click canvas pan, and Trix C-Track catalog.
Release 0.2.0: Multi-platform builds (macOS, Windows, Linux x64/arm64), layer management, voltage simulation, and improved UI.
